title: Hide and rename the 'Supply Risk Verify' drillthrough target page
description:
fabric/oem_report.Report/definition/pages/50de95325943590837ab/page.json is a genuine drillthrough target — pageBinding.type == 'Drillthrough', bound to gold_supply_risk[is_bottleneck] with howCreated 'Drillthrough'. It carries no visibility property, so unlike a conventional drillthrough target it renders as an ordinary tab in the page strip. A reader who clicks it directly lands on a page pre-filtered to is_bottleneck = true with no drillthrough context to explain the filter.

The display name 'Supply Risk Verify' is also developer-scratch naming on a user-facing tab.

DO: set the page's visibility to HiddenInViewMode so it is reachable only via drillthrough, and rename it to something a reader would understand as a detail view (e.g. 'Bottleneck Detail'). Confirm the drillthrough from the Supply Risk page still lands correctly after the change — hiding a page must not break its pageBinding.
acceptanceCriteria: The page is set to HiddenInViewMode and no longer appears in the page strip in view mode.
The page is renamed from the scratch name 'Supply Risk Verify' to a reader-facing detail-view name.
The drillthrough from the Supply Risk page still lands on the target correctly after the change.

issues.description: PRE-EXISTING, confirmed from model semantics (not measured in the rendered table): on Bottleneck Detail the page filter gold_supply_risk[is_bottleneck]=true does not reach the 'Top Supplier Share (Plain, global)' column. (a) relationships are single-direction dim->fact, so a gold_supply_risk filter never reaches gold_dim_material/gold_dim_stage and hence never fact_supply_share; (b) the measure Supply Concentration Index = CALCULATE(MAX(fact_supply_share[share_pct]), fact_supply_share[supply_mix]="global") references no gold_supply_risk column; (c) all 6 visual-level filters on tableEx 47d13637dd6cc7a41b48 are empty; (d) gold_supply_risk keeps and flags the non-bottleneck stage. So (material, non-bottleneck stage) rows can appear with blank Supply Risk columns and only Top Supplier Share filled. HEAD had the same In[true] filter, so this predates task-080. The '85 rows' in task-038_6 was a T-SQL count, not a rendered table — the leak has never been measured. Suggested follow-up: visual-level filter 'Supply Risk (Global) is not blank' on 47d13637.

Inherent to option A: Executive Dashboard clusteredColumnChart 18c9cfb2b21cce6ba01c projects gold_dim_material.material_name_std as Category, so it also offers Drill through -> Bottleneck Detail. Confirmed the only drill source outside the Supply Risk page; Executive Dashboard has no page filters, slicers or report-level filters to carry extra context.
No cue on the Supply Risk page that the bars drill through to a hidden page. Microsoft's drillthrough guidance recommends a visual-header tooltip or text-box cue. UX only, outside the ACs.

Correction to the implementer's draft protocol step E4: '~85 rows earlier' is task-038_6's T-SQL count, not an observed render; with the pre-existing leak the table can show more than 85 rows. Corrected protocol checks that rows with non-blank Supply Risk (Global) match the SQL count of is_bottleneck rows.

Residual live-only risk: the new Drillthrough filter 5ec57ed274b151b58162 has no 'filter' body — schema-valid, no repo precedent; round-trip through fabric-cicd and the service is only observable after deploy (test_protocol E2).

test_protocol.summary: After Erik approves the push to main and the fabric-cicd deploy succeeds, confirm the page is hidden in view mode and a real drillthrough from the Supply Risk bars reaches Bottleneck Detail (AC1, AC3); measure the pre-existing is_bottleneck leak along the way.

steps.instruction: Pre-condition: commit and push to main, then confirm the deploy-fabric workflow run succeeded (pushing to main publishes the report).
steps.expected: Deploy run green. Do not continue if it failed.

steps.instruction: R1 (AC1): open the report in reading view and look at the page strip.
steps.expected: Four tabs: Executive Dashboard, Risk & Sustainability, Supply Risk, Data Quality Monitoring. No 'Bottleneck Detail' and no 'Supply Risk Verify'. Report opens on Executive Dashboard.

steps.instruction: R2 (AC3): Supply Risk page — right-click any bar in the LEFT chart ('EU sourcing vs world production — concentration contrast'), hover 'Drill through'. Repeat on any bar in the RIGHT chart ('Governance- and trade-weighted HHI — global vs EU sourcing').
steps.expected: Both charts offer 'Bottleneck Detail' under Drill through.

steps.instruction: R3 (AC3): in the RIGHT chart note the Global bar value for a material X, then drill through on that bar.
steps.expected: Lands on Bottleneck Detail; filter pane shows material_name_std = X; exactly one row for X has non-blank Supply Risk (Global) and it equals X's Global bar. Compare the Global bar only, NOT the EU bar (EU is the max over all stages). A second X row with blank Supply Risk columns and only Top Supplier Share filled is the pre-existing leak, not a drill failure — note whether it appears.

steps.instruction: R4: click the Back button (top-left of Bottleneck Detail).
steps.expected: Returns to the Supply Risk page.

steps.instruction: R5 (edge case): on the SQL analytics endpoint run the query; if it returns a material that also has a bar on the Supply Risk page, drill through on it.
steps.expected: No error; Supply Risk columns blank for that material; at most leak rows with Top Supplier Share. Empty query result is fine — skip the drill.
steps.command: SELECT m.material_name_std FROM gold_supply_risk r JOIN gold_dim_material m ON r.material_key = m.material_key GROUP BY m.material_name_std HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_bottleneck = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0

steps.instruction: R6: Executive Dashboard — right-click a bar in the Total Spend by material column chart, hover 'Drill through'.
steps.expected: 'Bottleneck Detail' is offered (expected side effect of option A).

steps.instruction: E1: switch to edit mode and look at the page tabs.
steps.expected: 'Bottleneck Detail' appears with the hidden-page icon.

steps.instruction: E2 (falsifier): on Bottleneck Detail open Visualizations pane -> Drillthrough.
steps.expected: Well holds material_name_std (All); Keep all filters On; Cross-report Off; is_bottleneck NOT in the well. If is_bottleneck is there or the well is empty, the service rewrote the binding — screenshot E2 and E3 and do NOT hand-fix in the Fabric UI (repo is authoritative).

steps.instruction: E3: Filters pane -> 'Filters on this page'.
E4 (measures the leak): open Bottleneck Detail directly in edit mode (no drill context); count (a) rows with non-blank Supply Risk (Global) and (b) total table rows; compare with the SQL count.
steps.expected: (a) equals the SQL count (85 on 2026-08-01). If (b) > (a), the extra rows are the pre-existing leak — report both numbers.
steps.command: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_supply_risk WHERE is_bottleneck = 1

Structural diff = exactly the 7 intended changes; no other report file changed. Model relationship cec812b3 carries the material filter to gold_supply_risk. pytest 349 passed. Live-only: view-mode hiding (AC1); drill offered, lands correctly, binding survives round trip (AC3).
